summary: No change this pass. The index has no open question or necessary gap, and every current account already carries its sources, counterevidence and limits; the only remaining items are the reopening conditions recorded last pass, none of which is present in the captured tree. With no concrete uncertainty to reduce, adding a record would be activity without evidence, so the draft is unchanged and the audit's product stands: one asserted witness-summary reporting defect, the remaining areas closed as explained or refuted with the receipts and source anchors behind them.
